_comment: Quality baseline: one full-tree violation count per tool. A baseline only goes down; raising a count needs the owner. Compared by dev/quality_baseline.py from make format-check, typecheck and docs-lint. The coverage floor lives in .coveragerc (fail_under). <pin> is the version in dev/tools/pyproject.toml or dev/tools/package.json.

ruff.what: ruff check diagnostics over audit, implement and dev (rules in ruff.toml)
ruff.command: uvx ruff@<pin> check audit implement dev --output-format json

mypy.what: mypy --strict errors over the typed scope in the Makefile (TYPED_SOURCES)

markdownlint.what: markdownlint-cli2 issues over every tracked Markdown file (the DOCS_LINT_PATHS ratchet is a subset and clean)
